messages.text: Morning. Legal DD memo from outside counsel landed overnight on Northwind. I've skimmed it. Three items worth flagging: change-of-control provisions in two major customer contracts, a pending environmental claim at the Newark terminal, and an open wage-and-hour class action.
Thanks Susan. Which two customer contracts have the CoC language? Are they consent rights or termination rights?

Both are termination rights on 60 days' notice post-closing. Together they're roughly 18% of Northwind LTM revenue per the data room schedule. Counsel suggests we seek pre-signing consents or a closing condition.
That's material for Meridian's model. Let's put a sensitivity in the revenue build with both contracts lost vs. retained. Can you do that by EOD?
Yep, will do. I'll add a toggle on the summary tab so we can flex it live.
On the environmental claim, what's the reserve Northwind has booked and what's counsel's read on exposure? I want to know if this is an indemnity item or a price item.

They've reserved $4.5M. Counsel thinks the range is $3M to $11M, with remediation cost the big swing factor. Recommends a special indemnity with escrow rather than a price cut, since the Phase II work isn't finished.

Quick compliance note for the channel: this DD memo is privileged and wall-crossed only. Please don't forward it outside this channel or paste excerpts into email threads. Anything that needs to go to Meridian goes through counsel's secure room.
Understood, Marcus. We're keeping it all here. Susan, please make sure the sensitivity file lives in the Falcon folder only.
Already saved there. Access list is deal team only.
Also, has anyone outside the wall-crossed list asked about Falcon this week? Want to log any inquiries before the restricted list update goes out.
Nothing from me. Trading did ask a generic question on Monday about whether we had any logistics names on the watch list, but I didn't confirm anything.
Good. Send me a short note on who asked and when, and I'll file it. We'll add Northwind to the restricted list today either way.

Sensitivity is done. Losing both contracts takes about $140M off the implied EV at Meridian's multiple. Retaining one cuts it to roughly $70M. Tab is called CoC_Flex if you want to look before the call.
